summary: Global reduced-motion kill-switch sets animation-duration:0.01ms but leaves animation-iteration-count untouched, so every `infinite` animation without its own override (LoadingSpinner brandmark animate-pulse, Loader2 animate-spin in loading-spinner.tsx noscript, cert-detail.css:2038 spinner, feed.css:1454 endorsement-multi-spin, domain spinners) loops at 100k cycles/s and shows a random frame per paint (flicker/jitter) instead of a static state. Also transition/animation delays survive (landing.css:810 300ms delay, fancy-tile inline stagger delays).
fix: In the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block add `animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; animation-delay: 0s !important; transition-delay: 0s !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important;` next to the existing duration overrides.

summary: Primary loader (pulsing Brandmark, `animate-pulse` 1.5s) has no `motion-reduce:` override, unlike Skeleton/Button/toast. Under reduced motion it hits the M01 flicker; even after M01 it would freeze at keyframe 0 (opacity 1) which is fine but implicit.
fix: Add `motion-reduce:animate-none` to the Brandmark className (Skeleton pattern, skeleton.tsx:43). Same for cert-detail.css:2038 `.cert-detail ... spinner` and feed.css:1452 `.endorsement-multi-row__status--writing`: add an explicit `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none; }` (keep the static ring).

summary: Input spinner is positioned with `transform: translateY(-50%)` and animated with `@keyframes spin` (`transform: rotate()`), which overwrites the centering transform while spinning: the spinner drops ~6px off-centre and rotates around the wrong point.
fix: Center without transform (`top: calc(50% - 6px)` / or `inset-block: 0; margin-block: auto`) and keep `transform` for the rotation only; or use the individual property `translate: 0 -50%` so it composes with the keyframe's `transform: rotate()`.

summary: Button base uses `transition-all duration-150` alongside `.press-scale`. Tailwind utilities load after components.css, so `transition-all` wins: every property (padding, width, gap when loading spinner toggles, border, box-shadow) animates with Tailwind's default cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) and `.press-scale`'s `transform var(--transition-fast)` never applies. Same `transition-all` in card.tsx:45/47, input.tsx:169, select.tsx:54, textarea.tsx:133, feed.css:544 (.feed__load-more-btn), components.css:1150 (.dashboard__back-btn).
fix: Button: `transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,opacity,transform] duration-150 ease-out` (or drop it and let `.press-scale` carry `transition: transform var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast)`). Card: `transition-[border-color,box-shadow]`. Inputs: `transition-[border-color,box-shadow]`. CSS: replace `all` with `background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast)`.

summary: `transition-all` on a `resize-y` textarea animates `height`: user drag-resizing (and any JS autosize) lags 150ms behind the pointer and triggers layout every frame.
fix: Use `transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150` so height changes are immediate.

summary: Mobile acting-as bar follows the navbar hide by transitioning `top` (layout) while the navbar itself moves with `transform` (compositor). On scroll — exactly when the main thread is busy — the bar animates on the main thread, can drift out of sync with the navbar and triggers layout each frame.
fix: Keep `top: var(--navbar-height)` static and animate `transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--navbar-height)))` on `.acting-as-bar--nav-hidden` with `transition: transform var(--transition-base)` (identical timing to `.navbar`).

summary: `.navbar` transitions `backdrop-filter` and `background`. Transitioning backdrop-filter re-runs the blur every frame (expensive, esp. Safari), and DESIGN.md §4 says the mode switch (default <-> profile overlay) is instantaneous — the 150ms bg/blur fade contradicts that on route change.
fix: `transition: transform var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);` (drop background + backdrop-filter).

summary: `.bottom-nav__item:hover { color: fg-primary }` is ungated and the bottom nav only exists on touch-sized viewports: after a tap the item keeps the hover colour (sticky hover), so it looks identical to `--active` and two items read as selected.
fix: Wrap in `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .bottom-nav__item:hover {...} }`. Same gating for other transform-on-hover rules: pages.css:849 `.apps-store__tile:hover` translateY(-1px), fancy-contributor-board.css:130/159/273, components.css:1914 chevron nudge, visualization.css:444.

summary: Bottom-nav press: `transition: transform` is declared only inside `:active`, so the press animates in 150ms but release snaps back from 0.92 instantly (visible pop). Scale 0.92 is also deeper than the 0.95-0.98 range used everywhere else (Button 0.98, navbar back 0.95, top-bar sign-in 0.97).
fix: Move `transition: color var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast)` to `.bottom-nav__item` base and use `transform: scale(0.95)` on :active. Update DESIGN.md §4 line 321 to match (M30).

summary: Sheet slides up (300ms) + backdrop fades in, but closing via X / backdrop / Esc unmounts instantly (`if (!open) return null`), while drag-dismiss slides out. Two different exits for one surface; the instant one teleports.
fix: Keep the sheet mounted for an exit phase: on close set `data-state="closed"`, apply `transform: translateY(100%)` with `transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` and backdrop `opacity 0` 200ms ease-out, then unmount on `transitionend` (with a 250ms timeout backstop). Reuse the same path for drag-dismiss.

summary: Drag-dismiss: (a) only a distance threshold (dy > 80px), a fast flick under 80px snaps back; (b) the slide-out transition is 300ms but `onClose` fires at 250ms, cutting the animation off; (c) backdrop opacity doesn't follow the drag.
fix: Track touchstart time; dismiss when `dy > 80 || dy / elapsedMs > 0.11`. Make the dismiss timeout match the transition (or use `transitionend`). Use `transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` for release/settle. Optionally set backdrop opacity to `1 - dy / sheetHeight` during drag.

summary: Expand/collapse animates `max-height` (70vh -> 92vh) via `transition-[max-height] duration-300` (and the drag hook's inline `max-height 0.3s`; duplicate rule in pages.css:701). Layout every frame on mobile; entry keyframe uses plain `ease-out` while DESIGN.md says bottom sheets use the house spring curve.
fix: Acceptable to keep max-height (sheet content reflows) but use one source: `transition: max-height 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`; entry `animate-[bottomSheetSlideUp_300ms_cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)]` or the house curve. Remove the stale pages.css:701 rule if the Tailwind class is canonical.

summary: DESIGN.md §4 says modal entry = backdrop fades in 200ms while content slides up. AppDialog animates the panel (`modalSlideUp 300ms` house curve) but `::backdrop` has no animation, so the dim snaps on instantly under a gliding panel.
fix: Add `motion-safe:backdrop:animate-[modalFadeIn_200ms_ease-out]` to the dialog class list.

summary: `@keyframes modalFadeIn` / `modalSlideUp` are defined twice (components.css:115/120 and landing.css:1455/1460, identical). The later one silently wins; editing one copy has no effect.
fix: Delete the landing.css copies (components.css is imported first and is the app-wide home).

summary: If the route hasn't rendered within 500ms the backstop resolves the update callback anyway: the browser then animates old snapshot -> (unchanged) old DOM, i.e. the page slides out and the same page slides back in, after which the real route pops in with no transition. Input is also frozen for up to 500ms+280ms while the transition is pending.
fix: On backstop, call `transition.skipTransition()` (keep a ref to the transition) instead of letting the slide play against stale DOM; optionally lower the backstop to ~300ms and prefetch TransitionLink targets so the commit usually lands first.

summary: Mobile page slide animates the whole `root`, so the fixed navbar and bottom nav slide out with the page — persistent chrome should stay put (the desktop path already avoids this for the same reason).
fix: Give `.navbar` `view-transition-name: site-navbar` and `.bottom-nav` `view-transition-name: bottom-nav`, and add `::view-transition-group(site-navbar), ::view-transition-group(bottom-nav) { animation: none; }` (guard against duplicate names when the navbar is hidden).

summary: Desktop tab switch (profile / project / activity tabs, tens of times a day) re-mounts the panel with a 300ms, 64px slide+fade. For a frequent action that is long and travels far; the content also starts at opacity 0 so it feels like a delay.
fix: `tab-panel-in-*`: `from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(±12px) }`, `animation: 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both`. Keep the reduced-motion `animation: none`.

summary: The animation is implemented by `key={activeKey}` on the wrapper, which re-mounts the entire subtree on every tab change (state, scroll inside panels, in-flight fetch hooks reset) purely to restart a keyframe. Also during the 300ms the transformed wrapper becomes the containing block for any non-portaled `position: fixed` descendant.
fix: Keep the key only if per-tab remount is desired; otherwise restart the animation without remount (toggle the class and force restart via `el.getAnimations()` / WAAPI `el.animate([...], {duration:180, easing:'cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)'})` in a layout effect).

summary: Force-graph camera animations (`zoomToFit(700…)`, `zoomToFit(400…)` on engine stop and on the fit button) and the live force simulation (cooldownTicks=120, nodes drifting on screen) are JS-driven and ignore prefers-reduced-motion; the CSS kill-switch can't reach canvas.
fix: Read `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')`; when set pass duration 0 to zoomToFit and use `warmupTicks={120} cooldownTicks={0}` so the layout settles before first paint.

summary: Home re-tap does `window.scrollTo({behavior:'smooth'})` and the sheet's focus handler uses `scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})` (use-bottom-sheet-drag.ts:59) — JS smooth scrolling isn't covered by the CSS reduced-motion block.
fix: `behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth'` (small shared helper next to prefersReducedMotion in lib/view-transitions.tsx).

summary: Site drawer uses `duration-300 ease-out` (Tailwind's weak default curve) both ways; DESIGN.md says the sidebar slides in with the house spring curve. Exit at the same 300ms as entry feels sluggish when dismissing.
fix: Panel: `ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] duration-300` when opening, `duration-200` when closing (`open ? 'duration-300' : 'duration-200'`). Backdrop: `duration-200`.

summary: Toasts fade/rise in (150ms) but vanish instantly on dismiss/auto-timeout; the remaining stack jumps.
fix: On dismiss mark the toast `leaving`, apply `opacity:0; transform: translateY(8px)` with `transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out`, remove on transitionend (motion-reduce: remove immediately).

summary: Deluxe board tile hover: 700ms `ease` sheen glide, -3px lift + scale(1.025), shadow-lg, ungated on touch (tap leaves the tile lifted). Every tile also carries `transform: translateZ(0)` (line 103) — a permanent compositor layer per tile — and the 22s ambient drift animates a blur(8px) layer forever.
fix: Gate all `.fancy-tile:hover*` rules in `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`; sheen `transform 400ms ease-out`; drop `translateZ(0)` (the hover transition promotes on demand). Keep the drift (reduced-motion covered) but consider pausing it off-screen via IntersectionObserver.

summary: Paste-import progress bar animates `width`.
fix: `width: 100%; transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(var(--p)); transition: transform 200ms ease-out` (set --p on the fill element itself, not a parent).

summary: Three different pulse recipes: Tailwind `animate-pulse` (2s, opacity 1->0.5, cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1)) for <Skeleton>, `map-skeleton-pulse` (1.4s, 0.4->0.7), LoadingSpinner (pulse at 1.5s). DESIGN.md documents 0.4->1 over 1.4-1.5s. Skeletons also start pulsing on frame 1, so sub-300ms loads flash a skeleton.
fix: Override Tailwind `pulse` in tailwind.config.ts: `keyframes.pulse { '0%,100%': {opacity:'1'}, '50%': {opacity:'.5'} }`, `animation.pulse: 'pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite'`; delete map-skeleton-pulse in favour of `animate-pulse`. Optionally fade skeletons in with `animation: modalFadeIn 150ms ease-out 200ms both` so fast loads never show them.

summary: Spinner speeds diverge: 600ms (cert-detail.css:2038), 800ms (endorsement-multi-spin, a duplicate of @keyframes spin), 1s (components.css:1025, Tailwind animate-spin).
fix: Use `animation: spin 1s linear infinite` (or Tailwind `animate-spin`) everywhere and delete `@keyframes endorsement-multi-spin`.

summary: 14 transitions hardcode durations/easings (`0.15s ease`, `0.12s ease`, `150ms ease`, `color 0.15s`) instead of `var(--transition-fast)`: feed.css:802/1006/1554, profile-endorsements.css:448, pages.css:629/654, tour.css:151, settings-page.css:605, cert-detail.css:1446.
fix: Replace with `var(--transition-fast)` per property (e.g. `transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast)`).

summary: Hero copy starts at opacity 0 and staggers 600ms with 0-300ms delays (last line settles at ~900ms). The h1 is the LCP element; hiding it until the animation runs delays LCP and the stagger is 100ms (above the 30-80ms band).
fix: Exclude the h1 from `.lp-hero__reveal` (or start it at `opacity: 1` and animate only `transform: translateY(8px)`); stagger 60ms; duration 500ms.

summary: DESIGN.md claims cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 'overshoots slightly before settling'. It doesn't — all control points are within [0,1] on the progress axis; it's an expo-style ease-out with no overshoot. Readers will expect bounce that isn't there (and the one real overshoot, groupBadgePop's cubic-bezier(0.2,1.4,0.4,1), is undocumented).
fix: Reword: 'a strong ease-out (expo-like): fast start, long soft settle, no overshoot.' Mention overshoot curves are reserved for celebration moments (group-created badge).

summary: Only three combined duration+easing tokens exist; the house curve is hand-typed 16 times (view-transitions.css, AppDialog, landing, components.css) and two other curves are ad-hoc. Durations 200/280/300 are untokenised; bottom-nav 0.92 press and tab-panel 64px slide aren't in the spec.
fix: Add split tokens to tokens.css and document them in §4: `--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)` (house), `--ease-drawer: cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)` (sheets/drawers), `--duration-instant: 100ms`, `--duration-fast: 150ms`, `--duration-base: 200ms`, `--duration-slow: 300ms`; keep `--transition-*` as aliases. Rule: UI motion <= 300ms; entrances use --ease-out; exits ~0.7x entrance duration; press scale 0.97 (0.95 for small icon targets).

summary: DESIGN.md says reduced motion disables all animations. Two gaps: (1) the 0.01ms trick needs iteration-count/delay resets (M01) and doesn't reach JS motion (smooth scroll, force graph, View Transitions — the latter already handled); (2) best practice is fewer/gentler, not zero — opacity fades that aid comprehension (modal/backdrop fade, toast fade) can stay.
fix: Document the full contract: CSS kill-switch incl. iteration-count/delays; JS motion must branch on matchMedia; scroll-driven + SMIL need explicit brakes (already in §landing); allowed under reduced motion: opacity-only fades <= 150ms.

summary: Spec says backdrop fades 'linear' (code uses ease-out where it exists) and is silent on exits, sheets' exit, popover/dropdown motion, and hover gating.
fix: Add: 'Exits are faster than entrances (~150-200ms) and leave the way they came. Hover-only transforms go in @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). Popovers: 120ms opacity + scale(0.97) from the trigger corner; no motion on keyboard-opened command surfaces.'

summary: OPPORTUNITY (spatial consistency, occasional): Popover/menus (account menu, row overflow menus) appear instantly with no link to their trigger.
fix: On the panel: `transition: opacity 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); transform-origin: top right` (top left for align=start); `@starting-style { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.97) translateY(-2px); }`. No exit animation (close instantly). Reduced motion: opacity only.

summary: OPPORTUNITY (preventing jarring change, rare/first-run): tour card and spotlight teleport between steps.
fix: Key the card by step and enter with `@starting-style { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px) }`, `transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`. Fade the dim panels in once on tour start (200ms ease-out). Do NOT animate the panels' top/left/height between steps (layout props).

summary: OPPORTUNITY (feedback): Switch thumb slides with Tailwind default easing; no press feedback.
fix: Thumb `ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] duration-150`; on track `:active` widen feel with thumb `scale(0.94)` — skip if it fights the 2px design language; keep current otherwise.

summary: REJECTED: sliding active-pill indicator on segmented controls / underline tabs. Tens of times a day, information-dense filters; colour change at 150ms is the right amount.
fix: None — keep transition-colors.

summary: REJECTED: press-scale / hover-lift on feed cards and list rows. Large surfaces scaling reads as wobble, and the feed is scanned constantly; the existing bg/border hover is enough.
fix: None.

summary: REJECTED: staggered entrance for feed/explore items and infinite-scroll pages. Core navigation surface seen 100+ times; stagger delays reading.
fix: None.

summary: REJECTED (for this pass): migrating to React 19 `<ViewTransition>` / Next `experimental.viewTransition` for shared-element card->detail morphs. Experimental flag + redesign of navigation; out of scope for a polish pass. Revisit when stable.
fix: None now; fix M15/M16 on the current provider.

summary: REJECTED: adding hover pulse/animated edges to the endorsement graph. Functional data the user is reading; decoration hinders.
fix: None.
